role: Abstract repeater/comparator: the one-directional power gate on a slab, with the input and side-input reads, the delayed tick that switches powered and unpowered ids, placement facing and the faced-neighbour notification sweep.
scope_reason: In scope: repeaters and comparators are craftable; placement, floor support, facing and the neighbour sweeps run in the oracle with redstone = off (onBlockAdded and func_149911_e ran in containers2-s42 and pickblock-s1).

members.name: canPlaceBlockAt
members.note: solid top and the default test

members.name: updateTick
members.note: Never scheduled for a repeater in this game: func_149897_b and onBlockPlacedBy schedule only on an input above 0 or a powered repeater (94), and nothing powers one (World.java:3511, 3585); the comparator overrides it (its record).

members.name: getIcon
members.note: the oracle dumps getIcon for every (id, meta, side) into rb_table.icon_index; table_icon reads it

members.name: shouldSideBeRendered
members.note: not top or bottom; render-only: every caller is the client renderer (RenderBlocks, RenderItem, ItemRenderer, RenderGlobal's outline, the item icon and colour hooks); row recordings draw no frames

members.note: the neighbour tail after canBlockStay: the comparator's override through comparator.c comparator_on_neighbor; a repeater's schedules only when its input disagrees with its powered state, and an unpowered repeater's input is always 0 (the powered repeater, 94, is never made in survival)

notes: Structure pieces never place diodes in 1.7.10; structure_blocks.c lists the class for metadata rotation. Power propagation would need a full port if redstone comes back. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/idxredstone 2026-09-27: exact. rs-diode-s1 places repeaters and comparators by hand on four yaws, cycles delays and modes, digs them and pulls their floors, and places, clicks and digs one of each facing a water pit that their func_149911_e rounds set flowing (a no-op diode_notify fails it at row 313).
